faq.question: What is Claude for Productivity, Skills & Artifacts?
faq.answer: Claude for Productivity, Skills & Artifacts is a 4-week, 32-hour practical certification course teaching professionals how to use Anthropic's Claude for complex document analysis, executive writing, Claude Projects, reusable Skills, and standalone Artifacts.

faq.question: Is this course suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes. The course begins with foundational prompting principles and clear instruction design before progressing to complex document extraction, Projects, and Artifacts. Anyone with basic computer and document literacy can succeed.

faq.question: What is the duration and fee?
faq.answer: The course spans 4 Weeks with 32 instructional hours (8 hours per week: 4 hours live technical instruction plus 4 hours supervised studio lab). The tuition fee is exactly ₹4,900 plus applicable 18% GST (totaling ₹5,782), under our Truth in Pricing policy.

faq.question: Do I need coding knowledge?
faq.answer: No. The core course requires zero programming, coding, or software engineering experience. It focuses on end-user productivity, business prompt design, document synthesis, and native Claude capabilities.

faq.question: Will I learn complex document analysis?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 02 provides dedicated training in ingesting, analyzing, and synthesizing long PDFs, business contracts, policy manuals, and technical specifications, identifying risks, gaps, and operational requirements.

faq.question: Does the course include business reports and proposals?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn to draft executive summaries, detailed management reports, commercial client proposals, and requirements documents adhering to professional structure and brand tone.

faq.question: Will I learn Claude Projects?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 03 covers creating and managing Claude Projects, configuring tailored project instructions, curating reference knowledge bases, and executing document-grounded queries.

faq.question: What are Claude Skills?
faq.answer: Claude Skills are Anthropic's framework for packaging reusable task instructions, operating procedures, supporting resources, and templates to execute recurring business tasks with high consistency.

faq.question: Can I create reusable Claude Skills without coding?
faq.answer: Yes. In this course, you will build instruction-based custom Skills featuring defined triggers, input/output schemas, task instructions, and quality-control checklists without writing code.

faq.question: What are Claude Artifacts?
faq.answer: Claude Artifacts are self-contained, editable, and interactive deliverables—such as formatted documents, slide outlines, simple dashboards, and lightweight tools—rendered in a dedicated panel alongside the chat.

faq.question: Will I learn to create documents and presentations?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 04 teaches you how to generate and refine polished document artifacts and executive presentation slide decks with clear visual hierarchy and data callouts.

faq.question: Does the course include interactive Artifacts?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn how to design, test, and iterate lightweight interactive Artifacts (such as simple business calculators or KPI dashboards), subject to supported platform capabilities.

faq.question: Can Claude help compare long documents?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn systematic workflows to compare multiple versions of documents, analyze vendor proposals against RFPs, and detect contradictions or omissions across competing sources.

faq.question: Will I learn source verification?
faq.answer: Yes. Independent verification is a core pillar of the course. You will learn rigorous fact-checking protocols, inline citation verification, and hallucination detection to ensure every claim is grounded.

faq.question: Does the course include Claude Cowork?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 05 provides conceptual awareness of Claude Cowork and Anthropic's unified task experience, exploring multi-step planning, human review gates, and workspace permissions.

faq.question: Do I need a paid Claude plan?
faq.answer: No. Standard free Claude accounts or accessible tiers are fully sufficient for all core learning outcomes. We provide equivalent documented alternatives for any plan-restricted features.

faq.question: What practical portfolio will I build?
faq.answer: You will build the 4-component Claude Professional Deliverables Pack: (1) Complex Document Analysis & Evidence Review, (2) Research-Informed Business Report, (3) Reusable Claude Task Skill, and (4) Professional Claude Artifact.

faq.question: Does this course teach Claude API development?
faq.answer: No. Claude API engineering, Python SDK scripting, and endpoint coding are excluded. The course is dedicated to end-user productivity, business operations, and knowledge work.

faq.question: Does it include Claude Code programming?
faq.answer: No. Claude Code terminal development and software engineering are deliberately excluded to focus on business documentation, analysis, and professional deliverables.

faq.question: Is this an official Anthropic certification?
faq.answer: No. This is an independent professional skill certification issued by Nova Skills based on practical portfolio evaluation. Nova Skills is an independent educational institution.

faq.question: How is this different from ChatGPT or Gemini productivity courses?
faq.answer: The approved transparent course fee for Claude for Productivity, Skills & Artifacts is ₹4,900 (statutory 18% GST extra). Nova Skills maintains absolute pricing integrity with zero hidden administrative fees. Flexible installment options are available.

faq.question: What career applications can I explore?
faq.answer: Graduates apply these skills in roles such as AI-Assisted Business Documentation Specialist, Research Support Assistant, Business Reporting Coordinator, Knowledge Management Assistant, and Proposal Writing Specialist.
